annotations.title: Inguza, CCU, AO Current Weather - The Weather Network

PART B  
TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR BIDDING

Inguza

content.text:
Search results for **“Inguza”** include:

- **Inguza predemersus** — an extinct, monotypic genus of penguin known from Late Pliocene fossils found at Langebaanweg, South Africa, dating to roughly 5 million years ago. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inguza?utm_source=openai))
- **Inguza, Angola** — a locality in Cuando Cubango Province. ([theweathernetwork.com](https://www.theweathernetwork.com/en/city/ao/kuando-cubango/inguza/current?utm_source=openai))
- **Inguza Hill Local Municipality** — a municipality in South Africa. ([softkings.rfqguy.co.za](https://softkings.rfqguy.co.za/storage/rfq_documents/2291/tender-document-logistics-for-tourism-indaba-2026pdf-69cb9b60a4366.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **Inguza in Final Fantasy XI** — a bird-like “Monipulator” creature related to the Apkallu family. ([ffxiclopedia.fandom.com](https://ffxiclopedia.fandom.com/wiki/Inguza_%28MON%29?utm_source=openai))

The most prominent result is the **extinct penguin genus**.
